in_english.name: Ateer
in_english.long_meaning: Ateer is an Islamic name derived from the Arabic root 'A-R-T', meaning 'fragrant', 'sweet scent', or 'aroma'. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 26, as a description of the pleasant scent of the Prophet Muhammad's perfume. In Islamic tradition, Ateer is associated with pleasantness, beauty, and spiritual growth.
